subject: Next steps: ops immersion slot + preparatory checklist
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@neuralpath.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: ops immersion slot + preparatory checklist

Hi Elena —

Great to chat this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: 60–90m ops/ML-infra immersion to validate performance, integration points (auth/ingest), and cost profile for your ingestion patterns.
- Suggested attendees: 1x infra owner (NeuralPath), 2x infra/ML engineers (NeuralPath), 2x Redwood ops/engineers (Monica + Priyom), and me to run the mutual action plan.

As for timing, we typically run a 75-minute slot that includes: 20m architecture & constraints, 25m live demo (representative workload), 20m perf/cost Q&A, 10m next steps & M.A.P.

Can you confirm:
1) Preferred week: Aug 24–28 or Sep 1–4?
2) Timezone preference (PST/EST)?
3) Any hard blockers (air-gapped environment, required auditors on call, or restricted access)?

I've attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan workbook; if you confirm a week/time I’ll coordinate the invite and lock the engineer roster.

Thanks — look forward to aligning schedules.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda), mutual-action-plan-neuralpath.xlsx (MAP workbook)

From: Elena Morales <elena@neuralpath.ai>

Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: ops immersion slot + preparatory checklist

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Week preference: Aug 31–Sep 4 would be best (we have a sprint demo the week of Aug 24).
2) Timezone: Our infra lead is in EST; afternoon PST (17:00 PST / 20:00 EST) works for us for a 75min block, or we can do mid-morning EST (11:00 EST) if that helps your engineers.
3) Blockers: Not air-gapped, but we do have strict data retention rules for logs — we won’t provide production logs, only sanitized traces and a 1000-record synthetic ingestion we can share. Also need a short SOC2 questionnaire answered before demo.

Sanjay will be our infra owner on the call — looping him in. Can you propose 2 slots next week that work for your ops team?

Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform, NeuralPath
elena@neuralpath.ai | +1 (212) 555-6610

Thanks Elena — helpful constraints. Monica / Priyom — can you confirm your availability for these proposed slots?

Proposed slots (75min blocks, PST):
- Tue Sep 1, 16:30–17:45 PST (19:30–20:45 EST)
- Thu Sep 3, 09:00–10:15 PST (12:00–13:15 EST)

Precall asks (short list so we can run the demo smoothly):
- NeuralPath to provide synthetic ingestion sample (CSV or newline JSON, ~1k rows).
- A single example request that represents typical sequence lengths / token counts.
- Answers to the SOC2 Qs we attached (I’ve flagged the 4 items our security team needs).

If one of the two slots works, I’ll send a calendar invite and pin the runbook and recording settings. If neither works, tell us two 1.5h windows that fit your team and we'll adjust.

—Rishi

Plan for the session:
- 09:00–09:10 — quick intros and success criteria (Rishi)
- 09:10–09:30 — NeuralPath architecture + constraints (Elena / Sanjay)
- 09:30–09:55 — live demo on representative synthetic ingestion (Monica/Priyom)
- 09:55–10:10 — perf, latency breakdown, cost levers discussion (Priyom)
- 10:10–10:15 — next steps and MAP assignment (Rishi)

Prep items (we’ll put an editable precall checklist in the Drive link):
- NeuralPath: synthetic dataset (by Sep 1), example request payload, and answers to SOC2 Qs.
- Redwood: pre-warmed model variant, demo notebook, and a short perf run to share baseline numbers.

I’ll draft the calendar invite and attach the runbook + a short readout template. Elena — if you can paste the attendee names/titles we’ll fill the invite and include any additional stakeholders.

Thanks — looking forward.
